answer: 1,000 fakes cost their farmer 1,000 separate vouches. Every payout needs a saffron stamp from a quorum of five randomly drawn peers, each staking their own standing on the signature. The nectar — the epoch’s reward pool — flows only after the quorum signs, and if the delta between claimed work and verified work is nonzero, the whole quorum loses standing. An honest agent pays one cheap signature per epoch, refunded on clean settlement. A farmer must corrupt five random strangers per fake, per epoch: 5,000 bribes that never repeat the same faces.
